cap_definition: half planned absolute order notional / prior NAV, using prior close
cap_exceptions: mandatory index exit or pure selling trim
vacancy fill if no optional pairs remain

risk_model.model: Conditional benchmark plus historical CSRC broad industries and three price/volume styles; NOT Barra/CNE5
risk_model.standardization: current historical CSI300 members; equal weighted, 5MAD clip; no cap proxy
risk_model.fit: equal-member cross-sectional residual regression with prior-close exposures; ridge1e-4
risk_model.specific: past252 EW half60, minimum60; unknown1 annual volatility
risk_model.benchmark_exposure: [1,0,...] conditional observed benchmark anchor; no invented benchmark weights
limitations: Historical classifications are archived monthly snapshots, not certified original vintages
Constant styles over the next day assumed
